:::{#hero-heading}

I do research at INRAE in the [DECOD](https://www.umr-decod.fr/en) research
unit, based in Rennes (Brittany, France).

My research aims to advance our understanding of the feedbacks between
biodiversity & ecosystem dynamics, of how anthropogenic pressures disrupt them,
and ultimately develop knowledge that might help us to restore them.

My work combines the use of theoretical tools, long-term monitoring data,
and experiments.

Informal contacts and enquiries are welcome.

:::

---
# This puzzle is amazingly complex: biodiversity changes depend on the population
# response diversity to environmental changes, which then scales at community
# level through a complex network of interactions among populations. These
# biodiversity dynamics determine ecosystem properties like the fluxes of biomass
# across the ecosystem
